question: Sion Heartsteel — is there an attack mode that prefers Colossal Consumption marks?
why_no: Ưu tiên tấn công only reads range and HP. It does not read per-target Heartsteel stacks or the 20s per-champion cooldown.

portrait_lock.vi: Khóa mục tiêu / chân dung tướng
portrait_lock.why: Tap the portrait of the champion whose Heartsteel mark is full. That is the only way to prefer a ready proc.

target_lock_filtering.why: Dragging the attack button stays on champions. Heartsteel only procs on champions; this stops the drag from snapping to a wave.

targeting_priority.value: Closest (Gần nhất) for melee Sion, or Low Health Absolute if you want carries — neither is Heartsteel-aware
targeting_priority.why: Closest keeps AAing the tank in your face even if that tank is on the 20s Heartsteel CD.

do_not_use: Quick Cast Empowered Attacks — Sion Q is not a Heartsteel proc
Follow attack / Đeo theo đòn tấn công — walks you onto whoever auto picked, often the same frontliner

how_to_proc: Stand within 700 of an enemy champion for 2.5s until their mark fills.
Basic-attack THAT champion (not a minion, not Q).
That champion is on a 20s Heartsteel cooldown. Cycle to another marked champion.

controller.gamesir_cloned_mode: Does not help. Cloned Mode taps two HUD spots at once; it cannot read Heartsteel marks.
controller.useful_map: Map extra paddles to enemy portraits 1–5 so you can lock the marked champ without lifting the left stick.
